candidates: ZERO_THREE_RIGHT / sensing Left  / 110 Hz / adaptive window 8-30 Hz / negative amplitude->power cluster
ZERO_THREE_RIGHT / sensing Right / 110 Hz / adaptive window 8-30 Hz / negative amplitude->power cluster

estimators.primary: StimOptimizer.routines.within_visit.band_cluster_permutation on log10 LSB power, cluster-forming threshold |t| >= 2.0, 2000 permutations of amplitude WITHIN visit, seed 0; statistic = mass of the largest NEGATIVE cluster
estimators.per_band_t: cluster-robust OLS log10(power) ~ amp + C(visit), clustered on visit, with statsmodels' finite-sample correction; reported but NOT inferential
estimators.unit: one row per clinic step = median across that step's settled tiles, settled = 45 s after onset to the end of the step's exposure window

entries.correction: Bonferroni across the TWO pre-registered hemispheres (0.05 / 2 = 0.025). The cluster test already controls family-wise error across the 18 band centres internally, so no further band-level correction is applied and none is needed.
entries.stopping_rule:
ONE prospective 110 Hz amplitude-ladder session on ZERO_THREE_RIGHT meeting the protocol requirements below. The analysis is run ONCE, after that session's data is ingested. NO interim analysis, and no second session may be added to the same test -- if a second is collected it requires a new registration, because adding sessions until a threshold is crossed is an optional-stopping violation whatever the nominal alpha says.
PROTOCOL REQUIREMENTS, derived from this record rather than chosen: steps must run at least 105 s (the measured 45 s ramp exclusion plus 60 s of settled signal, since the shortest durations in the existing record contribute zero settled tiles); the ladder must span at least 3.0 mA within the single session (the chronic five-era window managed only 1.0 mA and failed on separation); rate, pulse width and contacts must be held fixed for the whole session; and BrainSense streaming must run throughout, because the device-PSD source carries 251-797 tiles per channel inside clinic windows against 43k-63k for time-domain and cannot support this design.
entries.primary_outcome: Family-wise p of the largest NEGATIVE cluster, per hemisphere, declared positive if p <= 0.025. A positive cluster, however large, is NOT a positive result: the Dual Threshold control law requires power to FALL as amplitude rises, so a rise is the positive-feedback direction and counts as a refusal.
entries.notes:
WHY THIS EXISTS. Every amplitude-response finding in this project to date is selection-contaminated by construction: 108 channel-by-band cells screened on the chronic record, 216 band-by-cell rows at 55 Hz, 22 within-visit cells across three rates, an averaging-window sweep, and a cluster-forming-threshold sweep. Retrospective p-values from that search do not mean what they appear to. Fixing the hypothesis, the estimator, the alpha and the stopping rule BEFORE the next data arrives is the only repair, and it is unrecoverable afterwards.

WHY THIS PARTICULAR HYPOTHESIS. It is the only place in the record where the sign is right for closed-loop control AND the cluster mass is substantial. Both ZERO_THREE_RIGHT hemispheres at 110 Hz show negative clusters at every cluster-forming threshold tested (1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0). It is NOT currently significant and is registered as a hypothesis, not a finding: Right reached p = 0.0470 at |t| >= 1.5 and 0.1614, 0.1659, 0.1524 at the other three thresholds, and Left never reached 0.05 (0.0740 to 0.1889). One threshold of four below alpha is selection, which is what the sweep was built to expose.

WHAT IS EXPLICITLY NOT PRE-REGISTERED, so a future reader cannot mistake exploration for confirmation. (a) The 55 Hz positive response on the same channel, which is established (p = 0.0005 at every threshold, both hemispheres) but is the WRONG DIRECTION and needs no test. (b) ONE_THREE_LEFT at 24.5-27.5 Hz, retracted: its cluster changes SIGN with the threshold, which is a noise signature. (c) Any band-level claim about WHERE the response sits. The cluster test establishes existence and not location (Sassenhagen & Draschkow 2019), so a positive result here licenses further work and does NOT license programming a band. (d) The 27.5 Hz subharmonic question, which is a separate mechanism (nonlinear entrainment at exactly 55/2) and needs its own design.

HARMONIC LANDINGS ARE RECORDED, NOT EXCLUDED, per the PI's instruction that subharmonic proximity is not contamination without clear and rigorous evidence. At 110 Hz with 250 Hz sampling the folded harmonics land at 20 and 30 Hz. The within-rate evidence against a contamination reading is that two channels on the SAME landing at 55 Hz move in OPPOSITE directions (p = 0.0000), which an alias cannot produce because it is identical on every sensing channel.
